04-bee-swarm-census.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Tol colorblind-safe palette and clever swarm+boxplot composition show real design intent, but the subtitle text collides directly with the P25–P90 percentile labels at the top, and the rightmost callout label is clipped — concrete layout bugs that prevent this from reaching 7.
04-bee-swarm-census.encoding_integrity_note: Log scale is appropriate and documented for log-normal income data, uniform dot radius encodes no size data (no lie factor), box plot and percentile lines are fully data-driven, colorblind-safe palette used — only weakness is a hardcoded X domain [14000,550000] that won't adapt if data range shifts, acceptable for a synthetic-data demo.
04-bee-swarm-census.stress_test_note: Fully static bee swarm (simulation pre-computed via .stop()+ticks, no brush/zoom/linked views); the only interaction is a trivial pointer-event tooltip using the unified PointerEvents API, so all five interaction-robustness traps are avoided.
04-bee-swarm-census.cognitive_load_note: Single-view layout with 4 colorblind-safe categories, pre-computed force simulation, and a supplemental boxplot keeps cognitive load low — the dense swarm core is readable and the percentile lines plus top-earner callouts add context without overloading working memory.
